text:
Michael Rasmussen's season has hit a rough patch. The Red Wings made him a healthy scratch in Florida in mid-November, and a Yahoo Sports headline carried the explanation: "Wrong spot at the wrong time." In his two games since, the 6'6" center has played under nine minutes each night.

The frustrating part is that his chances have been there. He has one goal on 4.3 expected goals (the quality of his chances), and none in eleven games. Over his last ten games his own expected goals ran ahead of his usual pace (2.9 against 1.8), and Detroit has scored 10.5 fewer goals than expected with him on the ice. At five on five the Wings take 51.1% of the expected goals with him on.

He is a checking forward who blocks shots (29) and kills penalties, a former ninth overall pick (2017) now working to stay in the lineup. Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level last season. Goals tend to follow chances; the question is whether he gets the minutes to wait for them.
headline: Michael Rasmussen is fighting for his spot
